metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.95 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and every frozen price-volume candidate through v1.5
metadata.formation_policy: At each close, compute the largest adjusted-close daily return observed over the current and prior 20 Provider sessions. The score is its negative and is first tradable at the following session open.
metadata.holding_policy: Use only the paper-supported one-month Mdr1 horizon: a 22-session forward label, Top 50, n_drop=1, and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the window, direction, label, validation segment, or execution contract after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: Mdr is the maximum daily stock return in the prior month. The paper reports a negative high-minus-low spread for Mdr1 and states that only the one-month holding variant remains significant in the post-2007 sample.
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: The paper uses previous-calendar-month formation, Mainboard breakpoints, value-weighted quintiles, and a high-minus-low portfolio. QuantaAlpha uses a rolling 21-session score in the point-in-time CSI300 universe and a long-only staggered TopK strategy. This is a tradable mechanism proxy, not an exact paper replication.

c2672568e33f0849.factor_description: Negative of the largest adjusted-close daily return over the latest 21 trading sessions. Higher scores identify stocks with less lottery-like recent payoffs.
c2672568e33f0849.factor_formulation: score_t = -max(r_d), d in [t-20, t]; signal after close t, earliest execution at open t+1

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks without an extreme positive daily return in the latest month outperform high-MAX lottery-like stocks over the next month.
